title: Controlled Boundary Resonance in Large-Scale Enclosures
description: Maps how room boundaries, subterranean volumes and non-parallel surfaces store and re-release acoustic energy, and turns that behaviour into a controllable parameter for loudspeaker-array composition.

title: Feedback and Physical Hysteresis as Expressive Parameters
description: The Institute's founding research line. Characterises intentional electroacoustic feedback loops and material hysteresis, and derives stable performance regimes from systems that would ordinarily be treated as unstable.

title: Non-Contact Optical Audio Extraction from Unplayable Media
description: Recovers audio from lacquer, wax and shellac carriers that cannot be stylus-played, using optical scanning of the groove geometry followed by geometric-to-acoustic reconstruction.

title: Magnetic Remanence Imaging of Degraded Tape
description: Reads residual magnetisation from binder-degraded and shed tape without transport contact, reconstructing program material from carriers that have physically failed.

title: Public Browser Instruments Programme
description: Engineering, accessibility and documentation programme behind the four instruments published on this archive: the Acoustic Bench, SPECTRA//LAB, SYNTHESIS//SIGNAL and VOID//OCULUS.

title: Autonomous Remote Listening Estate
description: Design, deployment and hardening of unattended listening stations: hydrophone arrays, infrasound lines, power plant, environmental protection and telemetry backhaul.

title: Long-Duration Infrasound and VLF Listening Line
description: Continuous sub-audible and very-low-frequency listening across the desert and sub-glacial stations, building multi-year baselines against which anomalous events can be judged.

title: Continuous Latent Sound Synthesis
description: Navigates latent audio spaces for continuous resynthesis, with feature-extraction tooling and an evaluation protocol for judging whether generative output is musically usable.

title: Anomaly Containment & Decommissioning Protocol Development
description: Develops and drills the containment, isolation and decommissioning procedures invoked when an experimental system enters an uncontrolled state, and maintains the quarantined component register.

title: Anomaly Post-Mortem Programme
description: Systematic failure analysis across the archive: root-cause work on every recorded anomaly incident, published as post-mortems so that negative results remain citable.

title: Tactile Floors, Haptic Controllers & Microtonal Surfaces
description: Fabrication and calibration of physical performance surfaces: transducer-driven tactile floors, motorised haptic controllers and microtonal touch surfaces with sub-millimetre positioning.

title: Speculative Disclosure & Design-Fiction Patent Programme
description: Drafts the Institute's speculative patent dossiers in the register of patent literature, with prior-art critique and an explicit separation between design fiction and legal filing.

title: Open Archive, Structured Data & Preservation
description: Keeps this archive readable: static prerendering of every record, machine-readable structured data, revision-ledger verification and format migration for deposited material.

title: Soundscape Ecology & Bio-Electric Transduction
description: Baselines anthropogenic noise at the remote stations and trials plant bio-electric potential as a control-voltage modulation source for ecological sonification.

title: Kinetic Percussion Automata & Motorised Actuators
description: Solenoid-driven percussion, motorised acoustic actuators and self-playing mechanisms, investigated both as instruments and as a critique of automation in performance. Internally funded.

title: Multichannel Spatial Dome & Site-Specific Choreography
description: Loudspeaker-dome geometry, ambisonic decoding for non-ideal rooms and the compositional practice of choreographing sound through a fixed three-dimensional array. Internally funded.
